history.dynasty: None (modern; built by a devotee society)
history.summary: In 1989 a small group of Sai devotees in the then-developing township of Noida conceived a Sai temple, initially holding pooja, archana and bhajans at devotees' residences. They registered the Shri Sai Samiti Noida society in 1991, got a plot (64 D, 2, F-Block, Sector 40) allotted by the Noida Authority in 1995, and the foundation was laid on 23 November 1999. The mandir has a prayer hall and Dhyan Kendra for meditation, offers free bus service for devotees on Thursdays, and runs charitable services: a school for poor children, mid-day meals and medical services. IDENTITY FLAG: Noida has at least two prominent Sai Baba temples — this Sector 40 shrine and Sai Karuna Dham at E-4, Sector 61 (built under C. B. Satpathy, main temple consecrated 13 April 2003). The CSV's generic 'Sai Mandir, Noida' could refer to either; this record documents the Sector 40 Shri Sai Samiti shrine.

name: Sai Mandir
town_description: Noida is a planned city in Gautam Buddha Nagar district, Uttar Pradesh, across the Yamuna from Delhi and part of the National Capital Region. A major IT and industrial hub, it is laid out in numbered residential sectors; Sector 40 is a residential sector in central Noida, close to the city centre and the Noida City Centre metro station.

travel.airport: Indira Gandhi International Airport, Delhi (approx. 35-45 km; taxis, app cabs, metro links available).
travel.railway: New Delhi and Ghaziabad Junctions (approx. 25-30 km); nearest metro: Noida City Centre / Botanical Garden on the Blue Line.
travel.road: Well connected by Noida Metro (Blue Line) and city buses; the temple at F-Block, Sector 40 is easily reached by auto-rickshaw and taxi within Noida.

visitor_information.best_time: October to March, when the weather is pleasant. Ram Navami, Guru Purnima and Punyatithi (Dussehra) draw the largest crowds; Thursdays are the weekly devotional day.
visitor_information.opening_hours: Daily 5:30/6:00 AM to 10:00 PM (sources vary on the morning opening: 6:00 AM per 5BestInCity, 5:30 AM per Justdial listings). Free bus service for devotees on Thursdays.
